name: geplex
description: Connect Codex to a scoped GepLex instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped GepLex tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to GepLex through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so GepLex Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use GepLex only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
